palette.notes: Code: 25 colours, 3 ramps, median hue shift 0.5 deg (flat, not hue-shifted), ramp length 8. Mint background, pale blonde hair, grey vest, white shirt, green and white striped tie and green hood.

lighting: Flat anime lighting from the front; minimal shading on hair and vest; soft pink blush on cheeks.
silhouette: Bust-up portrait of an anime girl framed on a mint card with a white sticker outline around the whole figure; long hair widens the shape.

motion.timing: Code: 6.64 changes/s, median hold 150 ms (p25 133, p75 167), on 4.5s at 30 fps; small loops of eye, mouth and hair moves.

texture: Clean pixels, almost no dither (code: 0.0007); thin dark lineart on eyes, light outlines on hair; a white sticker-style outer rim.
camera: Static framed card centred in a vertical canvas with white margins; no camera move.

acting.acts: Idle-plus-expression: blinks, small mouth and eyebrow changes and slight head and hair sway, synced to a trending sound (Malfoy trend) for attitude.
acting.depth: Single plane; the figure is the whole subject.

techniques: minimal expression animation on a held portrait
lip and eye changes synced to a trend audio
white sticker outline around the figure
flat pastel background card to isolate the character
fan-art of a known character riding a trend
feel: pastel card + held portrait + tiny blink-and-mouth changes on 4s + trend audio = cheap but alive character beat
for_fred: A held close-up of Fred or Pixie with only blinks, an eyebrow and mouth change timed to a sound can carry 2-4 s of attitude; keep poses held on 4s instead of moving everything.
